methodology: Findings of every rule on 34 public open-source repositories at pinned commits were sampled per rule, and each sampled finding was labeled true positive (correct by the rule's own definition), false positive, or noise (code that configuration should exclude, such as vendored or generated files). precision = tp / (tp + fp) over the labeled findings that occur in the measured run, rounded down; noise is counted apart. A precision is given only with at least 20 labeled findings, or, for a rule with at most 50 findings, when every finding is labeled and at least 5 of them are true or false positives.
